title: agoseris glauca var. agrestis
intro: Agoseris glauca var. agrestis, commonly known as mountain sneezeweed, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the sunflower family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of infection. The therapeutic actions of mountain sneezeweed include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
